messages.content:
A farmer has 17 sheep. All but 9 run away. Then twice as many sheep as
remain wander back into the field. How many sheep does the farmer have
now? Show your final answer as a single integer on the last line, prefixed
with "ANSWER:".

message.content:
Starting with 17 sheep, all but 9 run away, leaving 9 sheep.

Then twice as many as remain (2 × 9 = 18) wander back.

Total: 9 + 18 = 27

ANSWER: 27
message.reasoning_content:
Let me work through this step by step.

The farmer has 17 sheep.
All but 9 run away. So 9 sheep remain.
Then twice as many sheep as remain wander back into the field. So twice as many as 9 = 18 sheep wander back.

Total sheep now = 9 + 18 = 27.
